question: Blackpink, HyunA, Somi, Twice, Yeonjun - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All five have a song called Ice Cream: BLACKPINK with Selena Gomez (2020), HyunA (2012), Jeon Somi (2024), TWICE (2017) and Yeonjun (2026).

question: NCT 127, Blackpink, WHIB - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each act released a song called Kick It: BLACKPINK on Kill This Love (2019), NCT 127 as the 2020 lead single of Neo Zone, and WHIB in 2024.

question: GFriend, Moonbyul, Taemin, Dreamcatcher, GOT7 - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All five have a song titled Eclipse, for some the English title of a Korean name: GFRIEND (2020), Moonbyul (2020), Taemin (2018), Dreamcatcher (2021) and GOT7 (2019).

question: Mamamoo, Fifty Fifty, BoA, fromis_9, NCT Dream - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each act has a song named Starry Night: MAMAMOO (2018), BoA with Crush (2019), fromis_9 (2020), NCT DREAM (2023) and FIFTY FIFTY (2024).

question: ATEEZ, Oneus, Stray Kids, Oh My Girl, Wanna One - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All five have a track called Twilight: ATEEZ (2018), Wanna One (2017), ONEUS (2019), OH MY GIRL on a 2019 Japanese album, and Stray Kids on ATE (2024).

question: Oh My Girl, RM, Jihyo, Girls' Generation - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each act has a song called Closer: OH MY GIRL (2015 single), Girls' Generation (2022), RM on Indigo (2022) and Jihyo on Zone (2023).

question: EXO, Mamamoo, A.C.E, NCT 127, OnlyOneOf - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All five have a song titled Angel: EXO on its 2012 debut EP, a 2016 MAMAMOO sub-unit single, NCT 127 (2017), OnlyOneOf (2020) and A.C.E (2023).

question: FTISLAND, WJSN, Seventeen, NATURE - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each has a song whose English title is I Wish: FTISLAND (2012), WJSN (2017), NATURE (2019) and SEVENTEEN (2020).

question: i-dle, Kang Daniel, SF9, Omega X, CLC - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All five have a song named Liar: CLC (2017), SF9 (2019), Omega X (2022), (G)I-DLE (now i-dle) on I Never Die (2022) and Kang Daniel on Realiez (2023).

question: Brown Eyed Girls, YooA, i-dle, Baekho - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Brown Eyed Girls released Abracadabra in 2009; YooA (2020) and Baekho (2023) have songs of that name, and (G)I-DLE put out a cover of it in 2024.

question: Baekhyun, Seventeen, NCT Dream, Twice - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each act has a song titled Candy: Baekhyun (2020), TWICE on Formula of Love (2021), NCT DREAM (2022) and SEVENTEEN (2024).

question: ATEEZ, Cravity, BoA, Beast, Haechan - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All five have a song called Adrenaline: BoA (2010), BEAST (2014), CRAVITY (2022), Haechan on his 2025 release Taste, and ATEEZ (2026).

question: Stray Kids, Le Sserafim, Jaehyun, Beast, Sungjin - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each act has a song named Easy: BEAST (2010), Stray Kids (2020), and LE SSERAFIM, Jaehyun and Sungjin, who all released one in 2024.

question: Yeji, ARTMS, Infinite, Winner, BamBam - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All five have a song titled Air: INFINITE (2016), WINNER (2018), BamBam (2021), ARTMS (2024) and Yeji, who released a single called Air in 2025.

question: ATEEZ, Twice, Red Velvet, Kep1er, Oh My Girl - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each act has a song called Celebrate: ATEEZ (2021), TWICE (2022), Red Velvet (2022), OH MY GIRL (2023) and Kep1er (2024).

question: Jonghyun, Baekhyun, Baekho, NCT 127, B.I - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All five have a song named Elevator: Jonghyun (2015), NCT 127 (2020), Baekho (2023), B.I (2024) and Baekhyun (2025).

question: Girls' Generation, f(x), i-dle, IVE, ASTRO - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each act has a song called All Night: f(x) (2014), Girls' Generation (2017), ASTRO (2019), (G)I-DLE (2023) and IVE with Saweetie (2024).

question: Stray Kids, Suho&Wendy, Cravity, fromis_9 - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each has a song titled Cheese: Stray Kids (2021), fromis_9 (2022), CRAVITY (2023) and Suho with Wendy, a 2024 single from his EP 1 to 3.

question: WOODZ, Kai, VIXX, BoyNextDoor - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: All four have a song called Amnesia: Kai (2020), WOODZ (2023), VIXX (2023) and BOYNEXTDOOR (2024).

question: P1Harmony, ATEEZ, Day6, E'LAST - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Each act has a song named Emergency: DAY6 (2019), ATEEZ on The World EP.Fin: Will (2023), P1Harmony (2024) and E'LAST (2025).

question: Which group is this: Hongjoong / Seonghwa / Yunho / Yeosang / San / Mingi / Wooyoung / Jongho.
explanation: All eight names belong to ATEEZ, the KQ Entertainment boy band led by Hongjoong, which debuted in October 2018 with Treasure EP.1: All to Zero.

question: Which group is this: Keonho / Juhoon / Seonghyeon / James / Martin.
explanation: Keonho, Juhoon, Seonghyeon, James and Martin are the five members of CORTIS, the boy band BigHit Music put together in 2025.

question: Which group is this: Taemin / Jonghyun / Key / Onew / Minho.
explanation: Onew, Jonghyun, Key, Minho and Taemin were the five original members of SHINee, the boy band SM Entertainment launched in May 2008 with Replay.

question: Which group is this: Changbin / Bang Chan / Han / Felix / Hyunjin / I.N / Lee Know / Seungmin.
explanation: These eight make up Stray Kids, the JYP Entertainment boy band formed in 2017 around leader Bang Chan, who picked each member himself.

question: Which group is this: Haru / Hyun / Wumuti / Rui.
explanation: Wumuti, Rui, Hyun and Haru form XLOV, a group with a genderless concept that debuted in January 2025 with the single album I'mma Be.

question: Which group is this: Jungkook / Jimin / Jin / j-hope / V / Suga / RM.
explanation: RM, Jin, Suga, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook are the seven members of BTS, the boy band that debuted under Big Hit Entertainment in 2013.

question: Which group is this: Sunghoon / Jungwon / Sunoo / Jay / Jake / Ni-Ki / Heeseung.
explanation: These seven trainees were chosen in the finale of Mnet's 2020 survival show I-Land to form ENHYPEN, which debuted that November.

question: Which group is this: Taeyang / G-Dragon / T.O.P / Daesung.
explanation: All four were members of BIGBANG, the boy band formed by YG Entertainment, when it held its official debut in August 2006.

question: Which group is this: Yeonjun / Soobin / Beomgyu / Taehyun / Huening Kai.
explanation: All five belong to TXT, short for Tomorrow X Together, the Big Hit boy band that debuted in March 2019 with The Dream Chapter: Star.

question: Which group is this: Baekhyun / Sehun / Suho / Kai / Chanyeol / D.O / Chen / Xiumin.
explanation: All eight belong to EXO, the boy band formed by SM Entertainment that debuted in 2012. As of October 2026 EXO has nine members; the ninth, Lay, is not on this list.

question: TWICE has 9 members
explanation: True. As of October 2026, TWICE has nine members (Chaeyoung, Dahyun, Jeongyeon, Jihyo, Mina, Momo, Nayeon, Sana and Tzuyu), the same lineup it debuted with in 2015.

question: TWICE was formed on the survival show 'Produce 101'
explanation: False. TWICE's members were chosen on Sixteen, a 2015 Mnet survival show. Produce 101 was a different Mnet show that began in 2016.

question: Three TWICE members are from Japan
explanation: True. Momo, Sana and Mina are the Japanese members of TWICE, and their presence helped the group win fans in Japan before its debut.

question: TWICE debuted under YG Entertainment
explanation: False. TWICE was formed and launched by JYP Entertainment, the agency founded by J. Y. Park, not by YG Entertainment.

question: Tzuyu is from Taiwan
explanation: True. Tzuyu, born Chou Tzu-yu, is a Taiwanese singer from Tainan who moved to South Korea to train before joining TWICE in 2015.

question: TWICE's debut song was 'Cheer Up'
explanation: False. TWICE debuted on October 20, 2015 with Like Ooh-Ahh from The Story Begins. Cheer Up came in 2016 and was the hit that made them famous at home.

question: Nayeon was the first TWICE member to debut solo
explanation: True. Nayeon was the first TWICE member to launch a solo career, with her debut EP Im Nayeon and its lead single Pop! released on June 24, 2022.

question: Which company does EXO belong to?
explanation: EXO is a boy band formed by SM Entertainment in 2011, after the label's founder Lee Soo-man revealed his plan for a new group that year.

question: What year did EXO debut?
explanation: EXO debuted in April 2012 with a single on April 8 and an EP the next day; the group had already put out two singles before that debut.

question: What was EXO's debut song?
explanation: EXO made its debut with the single MAMA, released one day before the debut EP of the same name; the song was written by Yoo Young-jin.

question: Who is the leader of EXO?
explanation: Suho is listed as the leader of EXO. He was also the first of the future members to sign with the group's agency, back in 2006.

question: EXO originally had two sub-units. What were they called?
explanation: EXO debuted split into EXO-K, singing in Korean, and EXO-M, singing in Mandarin. The two units stopped promoting separately after the 2014 EP Overdose.

question: Which EXO song became their breakthrough hit in 2013?
explanation: Growl, the lead single of the August 2013 XOXO repackage, is known as EXO's breakthrough song; it passed two million downloads in South Korea.

question: K-pop albums typically come with a photobook
explanation: True. Instead of a plain plastic case, K-pop idol CDs usually come in custom packaging filled with extras, a photobook among them, along with posters and photo cards.

question: Each copy of a K-pop album contains the same photocard
explanation: False. Photocards are packed at random, so two copies of the same album can hold different cards, which pushes fans to buy several copies to get the one they want.

question: K-pop albums often have multiple versions with different covers
explanation: True. K-pop albums are often sold in several versions with variant covers; SuperM, for example, put out eight variants of its 2019 debut EP.

question: Pre-order benefits are special items only available when ordering before release
explanation: True. Pre-order benefits, or POBs, are extras such as photocards handed out for a limited time, usually to fans who buy an album before it comes out, and they often differ by store.

question: K-pop physical album sales count toward Korean music chart rankings
explanation: True. Korea's Circle Chart ranks albums on physical formats: its Album Chart counts CDs, LPs and other formats shipped, and its Retail Album Chart counts copies sold in stores.

question: Which group is known as the 'Kings of K-pop' from the 2nd generation?
explanation: BIGBANG, the boy band formed by YG Entertainment that debuted in 2006, earned the nickname Kings of K-pop and helped spread the Korean Wave to international audiences.

question: Super Junior debuted under which company?
explanation: Super Junior was put together by SM Entertainment founder Lee Soo-man in 2005 and made its official debut on Inkigayo on November 6, 2005.

question: Which 2nd gen girl group had the hits 'Nobody' and 'Tell Me'?
explanation: Wonder Girls topped Korean charts with Tell Me in 2007 and released Nobody in 2008; its 2009 US release made them the first South Korean act on the Billboard Hot 100.

question: Which 2nd gen group had the hit 'Sorry Sorry'?
explanation: Sorry, Sorry is the 2009 title song of Super Junior's third studio album, and its success brought the group international recognition.

question: Which 2nd gen group popularized 'beast-dol' (beastly idol) concept with powerful performances?
explanation: 2PM are credited with coining jimseung-dol, or beast idol: instead of the soft flower boy look of the time, the group debuted with a wild image and acrobatic dances.

question: What is a 'point choreography' in K-pop?
answer: A signature dance move that represents the song
explanation: Point choreography is the hook of a K-pop dance: a catchy, repeated move that fits the lyrics, as in Super Junior's Sorry, Sorry or Brown Eyed Girls' Abracadabra.

question: What is a 'dance practice' video in K-pop?
answer: A studio recording of the group performing the full choreography
explanation: A dance practice video shows idols performing a song's routine in one take, often in a practice room in casual clothes, with few cuts or effects so the moves stay in focus.

question: What is 'random play dance'?
answer: Songs play randomly and dancers must perform the correct choreography immediately
explanation: In a random play dance, songs are shuffled and cut off without warning, and the dancers must switch at once to the right choreography. Weekly Idol runs it as a classic segment.

question: Which choreographer is known for creating BTS's choreography?
explanation: Son Sung-deuk, a Big Hit choreographer, created BTS routines such as DNA and Blood Sweat & Tears, and shared the 2020 MTV VMA for Best Choreography for On.

question: What was the lead single of ATEEZ's album THE WORLD EP.2: OUTLAW?
explanation: Bouncy (K-Hot Chilli Peppers) was the single of The World EP.2: Outlaw, ATEEZ's ninth EP, released in June 2023; its dance mimics grinding and biting peppers.

question: I.N's real name is yang jeongin
explanation: True. I.N is the stage name of Yang Jeong-in, the singer who is a member of Stray Kids, the boy band JYP Entertainment formed in 2017.

question: Felix is known for his deep voice
explanation: True. Felix, the Australian rapper and singer of Stray Kids, is noted for his deep voice and deliberately uses it to strong effect on the group's songs.

question: Changbin is the youngest in 3racha
explanation: False. 3RACHA is Bang Chan (born 1997), Changbin (1999) and Han (2000), so Han is the youngest of the trio and Changbin is the middle member.

question: Woojin is the name of the member that leaves stray kids Woojin is the name of the member that leaves stray kids
explanation: True. Woojin was one of the original members of Stray Kids and left the group in October 2019; the band has continued with eight members since then.

question: STAY is the fandom name of stray kids
explanation: True. STAY is the name of the Stray Kids fan club, and the group titled its March 2026 anniversary single Stay after its fans.

question: LE SSERAFIM / ATEEZ / Seventeen - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: LE SSERAFIM (on HOT), ATEEZ (on Ashes to Light) and SEVENTEEN (on Face the Sun) have each released a song titled Ash.

question: TXT / Dreamcatcher / ATEEZ / Taemin / RESCENE - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: TXT (minisode 3: TOMORROW), Dreamcatcher (Raid of Dream), ATEEZ (Zero: Fever Part.3), Taemin (Eternal) and RESCENE (Dearest) have each released a song titled Deja Vu.

question: EXO / Somi / NMIXX / Say My Name / HUTA - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: EXO and Jeon Somi (both on albums named XOXO), NMIXX (Fe3O4: Break), SAY MY NAME (My Name Is...) and HUTA (Hook) have each released a song titled XOXO.

question: aespa / VIXX / A.C.E - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: aespa (on the Savage EP), VIXX (on Continuum) and A.C.E (on Under Cover: The Mad Squad) have each released a song titled Savage.

question: SHINee / JUSTB / Monsta X / Cravity - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: SHINee (Hello), JUSTB (= (Neun)), MONSTA X (Shine Forever) and CRAVITY (Sun Seeker) have each released a song titled Ready or Not.

question: IVE / aespa / fromis_9 / HyunA - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: IVE (IVE Empathy), aespa (Kiss N Tell), fromis_9 (Unlock My World) and HyunA (Attitude) have each released a song titled Attitude.

question: AN2DBLE / The Boyz / GOT7 / WJSN - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: AND2BLE (Sequence 01: Curiosity), THE BOYZ (a;effect), GOT7 (Dye) and WJSN (Sequence) have each released a song titled Aura.

question: Infinite / ATEEZ / Lee Chaeyeon / Oneus / Pentagon - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: INFINITE (Reality), ATEEZ (Golden Hour: Part.5), Lee Chae-yeon (Till I Die), ONEUS (5x) and PENTAGON (In:vite U) have each released a song titled Bad.

question: JYJ / LNGSHOT / Somin (KARD) - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: LNGSHOT (Shot Callers) and Somin (Where To Now? Part.2: Nowhere) each have a song titled Backseat, and JYJ has Back Seat on its album Just Us.

question: aespa / Baekhyun / VIVIZ / NCT 127 / Xodiac - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: aespa (Lemonade), Baekhyun (Essence of Reverie), VIVIZ (Beam of Prism), NCT 127 (Favorite) and XODIAC (Only Fun) have each released a song titled Lemonade.

question: ATEEZ / aespa / Oh My Girl / B.I / The KingDom - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: ATEEZ (Treasure EP.3: One to All), aespa (Girls), OH MY GIRL (Remember Me), B.I (Waterfall) and KINGDOM (History of Kingdom Part IV) each have a song titled Illusion.

question: Stray Kids / Babymonster / ATEEZ / Baekhyun / Xdinary Heroes - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Stray Kids (Karma), BABYMONSTER, ATEEZ (Golden Hour: Part.4), Baekhyun (Delight) and Xdinary Heroes (Overload) have each released a song titled Ghost.

question: BTS / SHINee / ITZY / VIXX - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: BTS, SHINee (The Misconceptions of Us), ITZY (Born to Be) and VIXX have each released a song titled Dynamite.

question: PIXY / Lucy / Key / AleXa / K/DA / Girls' Generation - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: PIXY (Reborn), Key (Killer), AleXa, K/DA (All Out) and Girls' Generation (Forever 1) each have a song called Villain, and LUCY has one titled 빌런, Korean for villain.

question: Block B / VANNER / Red Velvet / ALICE - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: Block B (H.E.R), VANNER (Capture the Flag), Red Velvet (Bloom) and ALICE have each released a song titled Jackpot.

question: AOA / EXO / SHINee / LOONA / Purple Kiss - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: AOA, EXO (XOXO), SHINee (Don't Call Me), Chuu of LOONA (her solo single) and PURPLE KISS (BXX) have each released a song titled Heart Attack.

question: Enhypen / ATEEZ / Cravity / Gfriend / JYP - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: ENHYPEN (Border: Carnival), ATEEZ (Zero: Fever Part.1), CRAVITY (ReDeFINE), GFRIEND (Fever Season) and J.Y. Park have each released a song titled Fever.

question: Katseye / miss A / tripleS / KARD - Which song title do they have in common?
explanation: KATSEYE (SIS (Soft Is Strong)), miss A (Touch), tripleS and KARD (Drift) have each released a song titled Touch.

question: Who is the leader
explanation: Bang Chan is the leader of Stray Kids; he chose each of the other members himself before the 2017 JYP survival show that formed the band.

question: What was their frist song
explanation: District 9 was the debut song of Stray Kids, the title track of I Am Not, released when they officially debuted in March 2018. Miroh came in 2019, Chk Chk Boom in 2024 and Do It in 2025.

question: Which MV has the most veiws
explanation: As of October 27, 2026, the God's Menu music video on JYP Entertainment's official YouTube channel had over 580 million views, over four times as many as the Do It or Hellevator video.

question: Who is the youngest
explanation: I.N, born on February 8, 2001, is the youngest of the eight members; Han was born in 2000, Lee Know in 1998 and Changbin in 1999.

question: What is there first album
explanation: Mixtape, a pre-debut EP released on January 8, 2018, is the earliest of these: All In came out in 2020, The Sound in 2023 and Hop in December 2024.

question: Lisa from BLACKPINK is from Thailand
explanation: True: Lisa is a Thai rapper and singer, born in 1997 in the Satuek district of Buriram province, Thailand; she moved to South Korea in 2011 to train.

question: Felix from Stray Kids is from the United Kingdom
explanation: False: Felix is Australian, not British. He was born in Sydney, New South Wales, in 2000 and later became a JYP Entertainment trainee in South Korea.

question: Rose from BLACKPINK was born in New Zealand
explanation: True: Rosé was born in Auckland, New Zealand, in 1997, was raised in Australia, and moved to South Korea after passing a YG Entertainment audition in 2012.

question: Shuhua from (G)I-DLE is from Japan
explanation: False: Shuhua is Taiwanese, not Japanese. She was born in 2000 in Taoyuan, Taiwan, and her native language is Mandarin.

question: Tzuyu from TWICE is from Taiwan
explanation: True: Tzuyu of TWICE is Taiwanese; her birthplace is Tainan, Taiwan, where she was born in 1999.

question: Soyeon writes and produces most of (G)I-DLE's songs
explanation: True: leader Soyeon is the group's main songwriter and is credited with writing and producing most of its lead singles.

question: (G)I-DLE debuted under SM Entertainment
explanation: False: (G)I-DLE was formed and launched in 2018 by Cube Entertainment, not by SM Entertainment.

question: Yuqi is from Japan
explanation: False: Yuqi is a Chinese singer-songwriter; she was born in Beijing, China, in 1999.

question: Minnie is from Thailand
explanation: True: Minnie is Thai; she was born in Bangkok in 1997 and auditioned in Thailand in 2014 before moving to South Korea in 2015.

question: (G)I-DLE's debut song was 'Tomboy'
explanation: False: (G)I-DLE debuted on May 2, 2018 with Latata. Tomboy arrived in 2022, leading I Never Die, the group's first full-length album.

question: (G)I-DLE originally debuted with 6 members
explanation: True: (G)I-DLE made its debut in May 2018 as a six-member group, releasing the EP I Am.

question: BT21 is a collaboration between BTS and which company?
explanation: BT21 was launched by Line Friends in October 2017; its characters were designed from ideas and sketches by the BTS members themselves.

question: Which BT21 character was created by RM?
explanation: RM created Koya, a deep-thinking blue koala with a violet nose whose ears fall off when he is surprised, and who is nearly always asleep.

question: Which BT21 character was created by V?
explanation: V created Tata, a curious prince from Planet BT with a red heart-shaped head, a stretchy body and supernatural powers.

question: Which BT21 character was created by Jungkook?
explanation: Jungkook created Cooky, a tough little bunny, pink with a single bold eyebrow and a heart-shaped tail, who loves boxing.

question: Which BT21 character was created by Jin?
explanation: Jin created RJ, a gentle white alpaca from Machu Picchu who wears a red scarf and loves cooking and eating.

question: Which BT21 character was created by Jimin?
explanation: Jimin created Chimmy, an eager puppy in a yellow hoodie whose tongue always hangs out and who loves playing the harmonica.

question: Which Loossemble song is this?
explanation: Sensitive was the lead single of Loossemble's 2023 debut EP, and the EP closes with an English version of the song.

question: Which Loossemble song is this?
explanation: Day by Day is a B-side on Loossemble's self-titled 2023 EP, and it is the only option made of three words, one of them starting with D.

question: Which Loossemble song is this?
explanation: Intro (A Butterfly's Signal) opens One of a Kind, the April 2024 EP; the other intro option, Searching for Their Friends, opens the 2023 debut EP.

question: Which Loossemble song is this?
explanation: Moonlight is a B-side on the 2024 EP One of a Kind, and it is the only one-word option with moon in its title.

question: Which Loossemble song is this?
explanation: TTYL has two unit songs on the same base track: Hyunjin, Go Won and Yeojin sing Confessions, while Hyeju, Vivi and Yeojin sing Cotton Candy.

question: Which was BTS's first all-English single?
explanation: Dynamite, released on August 21, 2020, was the first song BTS ever recorded completely in English.

question: Which was BTS's second all-English single?
explanation: Butter came out on May 21, 2021 as BTS's second English-language single; Permission to Dance followed on July 9, 2021 as the third.

question: Jungkook's solo hit 'Seven' (ft. Latto) is primarily in which language?
explanation: Seven, Jungkook's July 2023 single with Latto, is sung entirely in English, so it is not a mix of Korean and English.

question: What year was BLACKPINK's first studio album 'THE ALBUM' released?
explanation: BLACKPINK released The Album, their first studio album, on October 2, 2020, about four years after their 2016 debut.

question: Which song on THE ALBUM features Selena Gomez?
explanation: Ice Cream is the album's collaboration with American singer Selena Gomez, released on August 28, 2020 as its second single.

question: Which song on THE ALBUM features Cardi B?
explanation: Bet You Wanna, track 4 of The Album, features the American rapper Cardi B, who also helped write the lyrics.

question: How many tracks are on THE ALBUM?
explanation: The standard edition of The Album contains eight songs, chosen from more than ten new tracks the group recorded, and lasts about 24 minutes.

question: Put these boy groups in debut order (earliest to latest)
explanation: BIGBANG debuted on August 19, 2006, SHINee in May 2008, EXO on April 8, 2012, BTS in June 2013 and SEVENTEEN on May 26, 2015.

question: Put these 4th gen boy groups in debut order
explanation: Stray Kids debuted in March 2018, ATEEZ on October 24, 2018, TXT on March 4, 2019 and ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020.

question: Which debuted first: BTS or EXO?
explanation: EXO came first: it launched on April 8, 2012 with the single Mama, split into the units Exo-K and Exo-M, while BTS released its first single album on June 12, 2013.

question: Which debuted first: Stray Kids or TXT?
explanation: Stray Kids officially debuted in March 2018 with the EP I Am Not, about a year before TXT, who debuted on March 4, 2019 with The Dream Chapter: Star.

question: Which Stray Kids member is known for his extremely deep voice despite being from Australia?
explanation: Felix, an Australian born in Sydney, is known for his very low voice, which he makes a point of using to full effect on Stray Kids songs.

question: Bang Chan hosts a regular live broadcast series called what?
explanation: Chan's Room was Bang Chan's weekly livestream where he chatted with fans; he started it in early 2019 and the last episode aired in May 2023.

question: Which two Stray Kids members are from Australia?
explanation: Bang Chan, an Australian who grew up in Sydney, and Felix, born in Sydney, are the two Australian members; Lee Know, Han and Changbin are South Korean.

question: Who is the oldest member of Stray Kids?
explanation: Bang Chan, born on October 3, 1997, is the oldest member of Stray Kids, ahead of Lee Know (1998), Changbin (1999) and Hyunjin (2000).

question: Karina / Winter / Giselle / Ningning - Which group is this?
explanation: Karina, Winter, Giselle and Ningning are the four members of aespa, the SM Entertainment girl group that debuted in November 2020.

question: Haewon / Sullyoon / Jiwoo / Lily / Kyujin / Bae - Which group is this?
explanation: Haewon, Sullyoon, Jiwoo, Lily, Kyujin and Bae are the six current members of NMIXX, a JYP Entertainment girl group launched by its Squ4d division.

question: Lisa / Jennie / Rosé / Jisoo - Which group is this?
explanation: Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé and Lisa make up BLACKPINK, the four-member girl group YG Entertainment debuted in August 2016.

question: Irene / Yeri / Seulgi / Wendy / Joy - Which group is this?
explanation: Irene, Seulgi, Wendy and Joy debuted as Red Velvet in August 2014, and Yeri joined in March 2015, making the SM Entertainment group a five-piece.

question: Wonhee / Moka / Minju / Iroha / Yunah - Which group is this?
explanation: Yunah, Minju, Moka, Wonhee and Iroha form ILLIT, the five-member Belift Lab girl group put together through the survival show R U Next?

question: Yeji / Yuna / Ryujin / Chaeryeong / Lia - Which group is this?
explanation: Yeji, Yuna, Ryujin, Chaeryeong and Lia are the five members of ITZY, a JYP Entertainment girl group that debuted in February 2019.

question: Chaewon / Kazuha / Yunjin / Sakura / Eunchae - Which group is this?
explanation: Chaewon, Kazuha, Yunjin, Sakura and Eunchae are the five members of LE SSERAFIM, a girl group from the HYBE label Source Music.

question: CL / Bom / Dara / Minzy - Which group is this?
explanation: CL, Bom, Dara and Minzy are 2NE1, the YG Entertainment girl group introduced in 2009 that announced a reunion under YG in 2024.

question: Wonyoung / Leeseo / Rei / Liz / Gaeul / Yujin - Which group is this?
explanation: Yujin, Gaeul, Rei, Wonyoung, Liz and Leeseo make up IVE, the six-member girl group formed by Starship Entertainment.

question: Yoona / Tiffany / Taeyeon / Seohyun / Sooyoung / Hyoyeon / Yuri / Sunny - Which group is this?
explanation: These eight names are the current lineup of Girls' Generation, also called SNSD, the SM Entertainment group nicknamed the Nation's Girl Group in Korea.

question: Yuqi / Miyeon / Shuhua / Minnie / Soyeon - Which group is this?
explanation: Yuqi, Miyeon, Shuhua, Minnie and Soyeon form i-dle, the girl group Cube Entertainment launched in 2018 under the name (G)I-DLE.

question: Sana / Momo / Jihyo / Tzuyu / Nayeon / Jeongyeon / Chaeyoung / Mina / Dahyun - Which group is this?
explanation: All nine names belong to TWICE, the JYP Entertainment girl group that was put together through the 2015 TV program Sixteen and debuted that October.

question: xikers is the 2nd group debuted by which company?
explanation: KQ Entertainment debuted xikers as a new boy group, and the agency is home to two K-pop groups, with xikers being the newer of the pair.

question: How many members are in the group?
explanation: xikers is a ten-member boy group: Yechan, Hunter, Yujun, Seeun, Junghoon, Hyunwoo, Jinsik, Sumin, Junmin and leader Minjae.

question: What is xikers' debut date?
explanation: xikers made their debut on March 30, 2023, the day their first EP came out, about a month after their group name was unveiled.

question: What is xikers' fandom called?
explanation: xikers' fans are known as roadY, also written roady, the name the members use when they talk about meeting their fans on tour.

question: What was xikers' debut song?
explanation: Tricky House was one of two lead singles, alongside Rockstar, on xikers' debut EP House of Tricky: Doorbell Ringing.

question: Which boy group is xikers' direct sunbae (senior), from the same company?
explanation: xikers share their agency with ATEEZ, and members have described encouragement they got from these seniors, such as San and Hongjoong.

question: Who is the only non-Korean member in the group?
explanation: Hunter is Thai, which makes him the only member of xikers who is not Korean.

question: Following in ATEEZ's footsteps, what name was xikers known as pre-debut?
explanation: Before they were unveiled as xikers, the trainees went by KQ Fellaz 2, echoing KQ Fellaz, the name ATEEZ used before their own debut.

question: TXT's debut song 'Crown' was about growing pains and feeling different
explanation: True. Crown tells of a boy who wakes up with horns and pulls away from others until he meets a winged figure and learns to love himself; TXT tied it to the growing pains of adolescence.

question: TXT has 6 members
explanation: False. TXT has five members, not six: Soobin, Yeonjun, Beomgyu, Taehyun and Hueningkai.

question: Yeonjun is the oldest member of TXT
explanation: True. Yeonjun was born in September 1999, while Soobin (2000), Beomgyu (2001), Taehyun and Hueningkai (both 2002) are all younger.

question: TXT debuted in 2020
explanation: False. TXT made their debut on March 4, 2019, with the EP The Dream Chapter: Star, about a year before 2020.

question: TXT's fandom name MOA stands for 'Moments of Alwaysness'
explanation: True. TXT's official fan club name MOA is short for Moments of Alwaysness, and moa is also a Korean word meaning to gather or collect.

question: Soobin hosted the music show 'Music Bank'
explanation: True. Soobin became a host of KBS's Music Bank in July 2020, presenting it with Oh My Girl's Arin until 2021; the pair won a Best Couple Award for it.

question: Which company does Stray Kids belong to?
explanation: JYP Entertainment put Stray Kids together in 2017, the same year as the reality show that carried the group's name.

question: Who is the leader of Stray Kids?
explanation: Bang Chan is the leader of Stray Kids, and he personally picked each member of the band before its 2017 reality show was filmed.

question: How many members are in Stray Kids?
explanation: Stray Kids currently has eight members: I.N, Seungmin, Felix, Han, Hyunjin, Changbin, Lee Know and Bang Chan.

question: What is Stray Kids' fandom name?
explanation: Stray Kids' fandom is called STAY, and the band even dropped Mixtape: Time Out as a surprise single to mark an anniversary of the name's reveal.

question: What year did Stray Kids debut?
explanation: Stray Kids officially debuted in March 2018 with the EP I Am Not, after putting out a pre-debut EP called Mixtape that January.

question: Which member is known for his deep voice and Australian background?
explanation: Felix is an Australian rapper and singer known for his deep voice, which he deliberately uses for impact on Stray Kids songs.

question: What is the name of Stray Kids' producing unit?
explanation: 3RACHA is the main production team inside Stray Kids, made up of Bang Chan, Changbin and Han, while the other members often help write songs.

question: What does BTS (Bangtan Sonyeondan) literally mean?
explanation: Bangtan Sonyeondan translates literally as Bulletproof Boy Scouts. Beyond the Scene was added as a second meaning in July 2017, not as the literal one.

question: What does TWICE's name represent?
answer: Touching people's hearts twice - once through the ears, once through the eyes
explanation: J.Y. Park chose the name TWICE, explaining that the group would move people's hearts twice: first through what they hear, then through what they see.

question: What does EXO's name come from?
answer: Exoplanet - a planet outside our solar system
explanation: The boy band settled on the name EXO in December 2011, before its debut, taking it from the word exoplanet, a planet beyond our solar system.

question: What does IVE's name stand for?
answer: I HAVE (as in 'I have it all')
explanation: IVE's name is meant to call up the English phrase I have, the idea being to confidently show the audience what I have as a complete group from the start.

question: What does LE SSERAFIM's name spell when rearranged?
explanation: Revealed in March 2022, the name LE SSERAFIM is an anagram of I'm fearless, and it also nods to the six-winged heavenly beings called seraphim.

question: What does aespa's name combine?
explanation: The name aespa joins ae, from the initials of avatar and experience, with aspect in the sense of two sides, to suggest meeting another self.

question: Which of these groups is NOT under the HYBE umbrella?
explanation: aespa was formed by SM Entertainment, so it is not a HYBE act, unlike BTS, SEVENTEEN and LE SSERAFIM, which all belong to HYBE labels.

question: What was HYBE originally called?
explanation: HYBE was founded in 2005 as Big Hit Entertainment and took its new name in a rebrand that went into effect at the end of March 2021.

question: Which HYBE label manages BTS?
explanation: BTS is on the roster of BigHit Music, the HYBE record label that also manages TXT and CORTIS.

question: Which HYBE label manages NewJeans?
explanation: NewJeans is a girl group formed by ADOR, a HYBE sub-label, and it released its first single, Attention, in July 2022.

question: Which HYBE label manages SEVENTEEN?
explanation: SEVENTEEN was formed by Pledis Entertainment, which still houses the group and has had HYBE as its majority shareholder since May 2020.

question: Which HYBE boy group debuted through the I-LAND survival show?
explanation: ENHYPEN was formed through I-LAND, a 2020 Mnet survival show, with the debut lineup decided in the finale on September 18, 2020.

question: Which group has the most current members?
explanation: SEVENTEEN has 13 members, more than TWICE (9), Stray Kids (8) or NCT 127, which now counts seven members.

question: Which girl group has only 4 members?
explanation: BLACKPINK (Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé, Lisa) and aespa (Karina, Giselle, Winter, Ningning) are both four-member girl groups.

question: How many members does IVE have?
explanation: IVE, the Starship Entertainment girl group, has six members: Yujin, Gaeul, Rei, Wonyoung, Liz and Leeseo.

question: How many members does ATEEZ have?
explanation: ATEEZ is an eight-member KQ Entertainment group: Hongjoong, San, Mingi, Seonghwa, Yunho, Yeosang, Wooyoung and Jongho.

question: At which event did BTS speak at the United Nations?
explanation: In September 2018, BTS were invited to New York to address the 73rd UN General Assembly, and they have spoken at three of its sessions in all.

question: What campaign did BTS partner with UNICEF on?
explanation: Love Myself is the anti-violence campaign that BTS launched with the Korean Committee for UNICEF in November 2017 to fund programs protecting children and teens.

question: Which BTS song's music video broke the record for most YouTube views in 24 hours in 2020?
explanation: The Dynamite video, released in August 2020, drew 101.1 million YouTube views in its first 24 hours, then a record confirmed by Guinness World Records.

question: Which award did BTS win at the Billboard Music Awards from 2017 to 2021?
explanation: BTS won Top Social Artist at every Billboard Music Awards from 2017 to 2021, while their Top Duo/Group wins in that span came only in 2019 and 2021.

question: Which BTS album was the first K-pop album in the Billboard 200 top 10?
explanation: Love Yourself: Her opened at number seven on the Billboard 200 in 2017, the highest any K-pop album had reached on that chart at the time.

question: TWICE's three Japanese members are who?
explanation: Momo, Sana and Mina are TWICE's Japanese members, and the three also form the sub-unit MiSaMo, which debuted in 2023.

question: Which Japanese city is Momo from?
explanation: Momo was born in Kyotanabe, a city in Kyoto Prefecture, Japan, which makes Kyoto the matching choice among these options.

question: Sana is from which Japanese city?
explanation: Sana was born in Tennoji-ku, Osaka, and was already training at EXPG there in 2009, hoping at first to become a singer in Japan.

question: Which ARTMS song is this
explanation: Butterfly Effect is a track on ARTMS' debut album DALL, with Barrett Marshall and Moon Water among its writers, and it is the only option with Butterfly in its title.

question: Which ARTMS song is this?
explanation: Heejin released Savior, stylized sAvioR, as a solo rock single in November 2025; its capital A and R sit inside the word, as the last clue says.

question: Which ARTMS song is this?
explanation: Icarus, lead single of ARTMS' 2025 EP Club Icarus, has two music videos: a cinematic version and a club version.

question: Which ARTMS song is this?
explanation: Lucid is on Version Up, the 2023 EP by the trio ODD EYE CIRCLE released as part of the ARTMS project, and it is the only option starting with L.

question: Which ARTMS song is this?
explanation: Fans voted on the Cosmo app to choose songs for DALL: Birth won as the main song and runner-up Distress became the album's B-side.

question: As of 2026, Lee Know is the ambassador for which Luxury brand?
explanation: Gucci named Lee Know a brand ambassador in June 2025, and in February 2026 he attended Gucci's Fall 2026 women's show in Milan.

question: Lee Know is born in the year of-
explanation: Lee Know was born in 1998, a Year of the Tiger; as a tiger-year idol he was invited in December 2021 to perform SuperM's Tiger Inside on a special dance stage.

question: What was the name of the dance crew that Lee Know was part of pre-debut?
explanation: Before debuting with Stray Kids, Lee Know took part in dance competitions; in 2016 he danced at World of Dance as part of the crew Cupcakes.

question: Which song is this?
explanation: Wave was a lead single of Treasure EP.3: One To All in June 2019, and it brought ATEEZ their first win on a music show, M Countdown, later that month.

question: Which song is this?
explanation: Selfish Waltz is track five of Golden Hour: Part.2 (November 2024), whose title track is Ice on My Teeth, and Hongjoong is credited on its lyrics, music and arrangement.

question: Which song is this?
explanation: ATEEZ won an August 2020 episode of Immortal Songs singing Turbo's The Black Cat Nero, then released a Halloween video version featuring original singer Kim Jong-kook.

question: Which song is this?
explanation: Before debut, the members were known as KQ Fellaz and closed their 2018 web series with a music video for From, a song Hongjoong composed and produced.

question: Which song is this?
explanation: Adrenaline is the title track of Golden Hour: Part.4, the five-track EP that ATEEZ released on February 6, 2026.

question: Which song is this?
explanation: Wonderland was the 2019 single from Treasure EP.Fin: All to Action, ATEEZ's first full album, and on Kingdom they staged a reworked version, Symphony No.9 (From the Wonderland).

question: Which song is this?
explanation: Star 1117 is an R&B ballad on Treasure Epilogue: Action to Answer, the January 2020 EP, and ATEEZ dedicated the song to their fans.

question: Which song is this?
explanation: BAD is the title track of Golden Hour: Part.5, the fourteenth EP that ATEEZ released on June 26, 2026.

question: What does AKMU stand for ?
explanation: AKMU is the shortened form of the duo's original name, Akdong Musician, which they cut down in 2019; akdong refers to a mischievous child.

question: What is the relationship between the two AKMU members ?
explanation: AKMU is a sibling duo made up of Lee Chan-hyuk and his younger sister Lee Su-hyun, often nicknamed the Nation's Siblings in Korea.

question: How did AKMU get their start in the music industry ?
explanation: The siblings won the second season of the TV audition show K-pop Star (2012 to 2013), which made them famous and led to their debut a year later.

question: Which country did AKMU's family live in before returning to South Korea ?
explanation: Lee Chan-hyuk and Lee Su-hyun spent five years living in Mongolia before moving back to South Korea, and their 2016 EP Spring looks back on those years.

question: What was AKMU's debut album called ?
explanation: AKMU debuted on April 7, 2014 with the studio album Play, which Lee Chan-hyuk wrote and produced on his own and which topped the Gaon Album Chart.

question: Which of these is a title track from AKMU's debut album ?
explanation: 200% was one of the three singles that promoted AKMU's 2014 debut album, along with Give Love and Melted, and it led the Gaon Digital Chart for two weeks.

question: Which entertainment company did AKMU debut under ?
explanation: Once the competition ended, the duo joined YG Entertainment on an exclusive deal and released their first album there in 2014; they left the label in late 2025.

question: What is AKMU's official fandom name ?
explanation: AKMU's fans finally got an official name, Akkademy, in March 2024; it was announced for the duo's 10th anniversary and blends AKMU and academy.

question: How many members are there ?? -(+-+)-
explanation: Cortis has five members, James, Martin, Juhoon, Seonghyeon and Keonho, the lineup BigHit Music revealed in July 2025 before the group's debut.

question: When was theirs debut date? C:
explanation: Cortis made their official debut with the single What You Want on August 18, 2025, one week after their pre-debut single Go! came out.

question: Which BLACKPINK member is known as a Chanel global ambassador?
explanation: Jennie went from muse of Chanel Korea Beauty in 2018 to global ambassador for Chanel, and she fronted the house's Chanel 25 bag campaign in March 2025.

question: Which BLACKPINK member is a global ambassador for Dior?
explanation: Dior made Jisoo a global ambassador in March 2021 after she had worked with Dior Beauty, and she kept attending Dior shows through 2025.

question: Which BLACKPINK member is a global ambassador for Saint Laurent and Tiffany & Co?
explanation: Rosé was named Saint Laurent's global ambassador in July 2020, and Tiffany & Co. made her a global ambassador in April 2021.

question: V from BTS is a global ambassador for which luxury brand?
explanation: V was announced as a global ambassador for the French luxury house Celine in March 2023, and he also became a Cartier brand ambassador that July.

question: Which two SEVENTEEN members are Chinese?
explanation: Jun and The8 are both Chinese singers in SEVENTEEN: Jun grew up in Shenzhen, Guangdong, and The8 was born in Haicheng, Liaoning.

question: Which SEVENTEEN member is from Los Angeles, USA?
explanation: Joshua, born Joshua Hong in Los Angeles in December 1995, is an American singer who works in South Korea as part of SEVENTEEN's vocal team.

question: Which SEVENTEEN member is from New York, USA?
explanation: Vernon was born in Manhattan, New York City, in February 1998 and moved to South Korea when he was five years old.

question: What is Jun's full Chinese name?
explanation: Jun is the stage name of Wen Junhui, born in 1996, who acted as a child in films such as The Legend Is Born: Ip Man before joining SEVENTEEN.

question: What is The8's full Chinese name?
explanation: The8 is the stage name of Xu Minghao, born in November 1997, who belongs to SEVENTEEN's performance team and to the sub-unit V8.

question: Where is Dino from?
explanation: Dino, whose real name is Lee Chan, was born in February 1999 in Iksan, North Jeolla province, South Korea.

question: ARMY is the fandom name for BTS
explanation: True: BTS picked A.R.M.Y. as their fan club name at their first fan meeting in Seoul in 2014; it stands for Adorable Representative M.C. for Youth.

question: ONCE is the fandom name for BLACKPINK
explanation: False: ONCE is the fandom of TWICE, named after the members' 2015 promise to give back twice the love to anyone who loves them even once.

question: CARAT is the fandom name for SEVENTEEN
explanation: True: SEVENTEEN announced Carat as the official name of their fan club during a concert on February 14, 2016.

question: STAY is the fandom name for ITZY
explanation: False: STAY is the official fan club of Stray Kids, who put out a compilation on August 1, 2026 to mark eight years of STAY.

question: BLINK is the fandom name for BLACKPINK
explanation: True: BLACKPINK revealed BLINK as the name of their fandom on January 17, 2017, blending the words black and pink.

question: MIDZY is the fandom name for ITZY
explanation: True: ITZY announced MIDZY as their official fandom name in July 2019, a name that sounds like the Korean word for trust.

question: Which TV channel broadcasts 'Music Bank'?
explanation: Music Bank is the weekly music program of KBS: it airs on Friday afternoons on KBS2 and reaches viewers abroad through KBS World.

question: Which TV channel broadcasts 'Inkigayo'?
explanation: Inkigayo, known in English as The Music Trend, is the SBS music program and goes out live each Sunday from the SBS Open Hall in Seoul.

question: Which platform broadcasts 'M Countdown'?
explanation: M Countdown is Mnet's weekly music show, airing live every Thursday at 6 p.m. KST from the CJ E&M studio in Sangam-dong, Seoul.

question: Which TV channel broadcasts 'Music Core'?
explanation: Show! Music Core, often shortened to Music Core, is MBC's music program, aired live on Saturday afternoons from the MBC Dream Center in Goyang.

question: How does a group win #1 on a Korean music show?
answer: Combination of digital sales, physical sales, voting, and broadcast points
explanation: Wins come from a weighted mix of data: Music Bank's K-Chart, for example, blends digital charts, album sales, KBS airplay, fan votes and social media points.

question: The 'horse riding dance' is the signature move of which song?
explanation: For Gangnam Style (2012), Psy and choreographer Lee Ju-sun tried several animal moves before settling on a horse trot, where he mimes riding and spinning a lasso.

question: The 'TT' pose (making T shapes with hands over eyes) is from which group?
explanation: TT, a TWICE single from October 2016, is named after the crying emoticon, and the TT pose from its choreography became a trend in Japan.

question: The 'shy shy shy' dance is from which TWICE song?
explanation: The shy shy shy moment comes from Cheer Up, TWICE's April 2016 single, and it turned into a viral meme copied by many celebrities.

question: Which BTS song features a 'DNA' hand gesture choreography?
explanation: In the final chorus of the DNA video (2017), BTS hold hands and use their choreography to mimic the structure of the DNA molecule.

question: The 'gun dance' point choreography is associated with which BLACKPINK song?
explanation: DDU-DU DDU-DU (2018) is known for its finger gun move in the chorus; BLACKPINK said the gesture was added on the day the music video was shot.

question: What is a typical K-pop idol contract length?
answer: 7 years (often called 'slave contract' era is over, but 7 years is standard)
explanation: Korea's Fair Trade Commission brought in standard contracts in 2009, and under its rules an entertainer's contract may not run longer than seven years.

question: HYBE became the largest K-pop company by market cap in what year approximately?
explanation: HYBE, then named Big Hit Entertainment, listed on the Kospi in October 2020, and on its first trading day its market value topped JYP, YG and SM combined.

question: What percentage of revenue do K-pop albums typically generate from physical sales vs. streaming?
answer: Physical sales are still a major revenue source in K-pop (unlike Western music)
explanation: South Korea is one of the few markets where CDs still sell strongly: physical formats made up just over 40% of its music revenue in 2018, while fans of US acts lean toward streaming.

question: What is a 'fansign event'?
answer: An event where fans who buy albums can meet idols and get autographs
explanation: A fansign is a fan signing event; entry is usually decided by a lottery tied to album purchases, so fans often buy dozens of albums to improve their odds.

question: What makes K-pop albums unique compared to Western albums?
answer: They include photocards, photo books, posters, and other collectibles
explanation: Besides the CD, K-pop albums usually come with collectibles like photo cards, posters, stickers and printed copies of the members' handwritten letters.

question: What was the name of the group name that dreamcatcher initially debuted as?
explanation: The group first debuted as MINX in September 2014, releasing Why Did You Come to My Home as a digital single, then re-debuted as Dreamcatcher in January 2017.

question: How many members were in MINX?
explanation: MINX had five members, JiU, SuA, Siyeon, Yoohyeon and Dami; Handong and Gahyun were added when the group became Dreamcatcher.
